prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Deep Orbit cinematic cel-shaded narrative,1536x1024 landscape. First portraits establish fixed canonical identities, facial morphology and age, eyes/nose/jaw, hair, costume and equipment. Next approved room master for ROOM ARCHITECTURE ONLY, not diagrams or colors. Last reference exact restaging target. Restrained clean outlines and muted sage #6BAA8A, aged brass #A89060, charcoal/navy, natural skin, modest practical lights. No glossy or neon lime. Balanced stylized adults with coherent neck/shoulders/torso, plausible arm chains, exactly two five-finger hands each, natural chair/table support. Faces visible, eyes follow work or other crew, candid action and subtle lively emotion, no camera gaze or presentation portrait. Screens physically face actual reader; camera beside reader sees same front face. Every label, cell, line, arrow follows correct surface perspective. Remove outward handheld displays. Peripheral screens inactive. Only specified content, no fake numerical findings or extra diagrams. Demir seated RIGHT at bridge console, body and gaze turned LEFT toward the chart-data table, one hand on mouse, other rests on closed notebook. Eyebrows lifted with pleased recognition at seeing sensors separated; natural face and shoulders. No tablet. Main screen heading "Supplied grouping". Table headers "Sensor", "Moment 1", "2", "3". Exact rows A 2 3 4; B 20 18 16; C 5 7 6; D 8 8 9. Beneath table code "tf.tensor(streamValues)", next "shape [12]", final "No model trained". It is supplied chart grouping, not a learned result. All text/cells in monitor plane. Other bridge screens dark, warm restrained practical light.
